Drying the product on the filter funnel and transferring to a round-bottom flask

narrativeProgression.description: Scott explains the filtration setup and proceeds to filter the reaction mixture. He carefully rinses the product with acetone to remove impurities. He then dries the product on the filter funnel and transfers it to a round-bottom flask for further drying.

youtube_description: This is the procedure to prepare [PPN][P3O8(OP(NC4H8)3)].2H2O, a triphosphorylating reagent for C, N, and O nucleophiles as described in J. Am. Chem. Soc. 2019, 141, 1852-1856 (DOI: 10.1021/jacs.8b12204) by Shepard and Cummins. The compound is an activated form of trimetaphosphate, here prepared and isolated easily on the benchtop on a multi-gram scale.
